review.tagline: 18-lesson course on building AI agents with Microsoft Agent Framework
review.summary: A Microsoft course of 18 lessons on building AI agents, each with a written README, a short video for most lessons, and Python code samples in Jupyter notebooks. Topics include tool use, agentic RAG, planning, multi-agent patterns, memory, MCP/A2A/NLWeb protocols, computer-use agents, local agents and securing agents. Samples use Microsoft Agent Framework with Microsoft Foundry Agent Service V2, and some also support OpenAI-compatible providers such as MiniMax.
review.audience: Developers new to building AI agents, comfortable with Python
strengths: Each lesson is standalone, so you can start at any topic
Covers design patterns plus MCP, A2A, NLWeb, memory and deployment
Text, short videos and runnable Python samples per lesson
50+ language translations kept current by GitHub Action
weaknesses: Samples are built around Microsoft Agent Framework and Foundry, which need an Azure account
Some later lessons have no video
Cloning pulls large translation folders unless sparse checkout is used
Alternative provider support is only partial, per the README
needs: Needs Microsoft Foundry (Azure account), Microsoft Agent Framework, Microsoft Foundry Agent Service V2
Models: Microsoft Foundry models, OpenAI-compatible providers (MiniMax)
